title: Italian-Style Crispy Pork Ribs
description: A fusion of Italian flavors with the crispy texture of pork ribs. This recipe combines the tender meat of the ribs with the richness of Italian seasonings.
instructions: Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil and spray with cooking spray.
Rinse the pork ribs and pat them dry with paper towels.
In a small bowl, mix together the adventurous seasoning blend, garlic powder, dried oregano, salt, and black pepper.
Brush the olive oil on both sides of the ribs and sprinkle the seasoning blend evenly over the ribs.
Coat the ribs with crispy breadcrumbs, pressing the crumbs gently onto the meat to adhere.
Place the coated ribs on the prepared baking sheet and bake for 25 minutes.
Increase the oven temperature to broil and cook for an additional 5-7 minutes, or until the breadcrumbs are crispy and golden brown.
Remove the ribs from the oven and let them rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Cut the ribs into individual portions and serve immediately.
